### They’re talking about the scanners

### The scanners in the spotlight

**Article.** The PEPR Sols Vivants programme presents my thesis work on in situ soil imaging, and how digital tools are opening a new window on soil biodiversity: [Observer la biodiversité des sols à l'ère du numérique](https://pepr-solsvivants.fr/a-la-une2/observer-la-biodiversite-des-sols-a-l-ere-du-numerique)
